source_iss: ISS-3018 (closed 2026-08-01 by operator drain — this PROP is the structural fix so it never recurs)
why_human_needed: Targets are NEVER_PUSH source code (build.js) in PROP-051 disaster-prevention lineage; the directive itself mandates operator apply. Also ratifies the Part-D disposition choice (manifest-only retained as canary instrument vs. full removal).
problem: Transient per-run integrity artifacts (sync-workspace-runs sentinels, verify-pending-run reports, narrative-cite-audits, push-failure logs, git-to-fuse-divergence reports, integrity daily report-*.json, abort sentinels, prune-integrity run reports) are clone-written, pushed to git, then mirrored down to FUSE by build.js syncToWorkspace's append_only walker ('monitor/integrity/': 'append_only' → walkAppendOnly copies every new .json, recursively). prune-integrity later deletes them from git per retention policy, but FUSE cannot unlink() in scheduled sessions (deny-by-default is the 2026-05-21 disaster-recovery property and is load-bearing), so every pruned file becomes a permanent FUSE orphan. Candidates accumulate ~10-15/day; operator manually drains every 1-2 months (2026-07-08: 1,137 files; 2026-08-01: ~260 files, ISS-3018). These files are disposable forensic logs — their durable record is the git-owned *-archive.jsonl files + git history. Mirroring them to the disaster-protected FUSE space is protection-for-principle applied to throwaway logs; the drain burden exists ONLY because of that mirroring.
root_cause: The blanket 'monitor/integrity/': 'append_only' OWNERSHIP classification predates prune-integrity (PROP-051 Workstream C). It was correct when everything under monitor/integrity/ was durable; once retention-pruning was added, the combination [create-only FUSE mirror] + [git-side deletion] + [FUSE unlink deny] mechanically produces unbounded orphan accumulation. No single component is wrong — the composition is.

part_A_reader_verification.method: grep of monitor/prompts/**, monitor/scripts/**, build-scripts/**, build.js, test.js for every per-run pattern stem; each hit classified as clone-read, FUSE-write, or definition-site. Then a targeted second grep for ${WORKSPACE}-prefixed READS of any per-run integrity path (zero found — the only ${WORKSPACE} hits are degraded-path abort-sentinel WRITES in workspace-sync.md lines 47/127).
part_A_reader_verification.verdict: NO agent reads any transient per-run integrity .json from FUSE. All consumers are clone/git-side. Exclusion is safe for every pattern listed in part_B.

readers_by_pattern.report-YYYY-MM-DD*.json (integrity daily: decider reads via its SPARSE-CLONE re-include list (CLAUDE.md PROP-084: 'decider: report-*.json + latest-integrity-summary.txt + alerts.txt + prop-009-shadow.jsonl') — clone-read. integrity writes from its clone (structure-integrity.md ~line 1019). prune-integrity/archive-old-reports run in clones.
readers_by_pattern.sync-workspace-runs-*.json (step4c senti: sync-workspace-step4c.js reads the most recent sentinel from ROOT = the invoking agent's clone (INTEGRITY_DIR = path.join(ROOT,...)); dome-mirror.md commits them FROM the clone (git add from $CLONE). check-delete-propagation-backlog.js (PROP-125 canary) reads via --root "$(pwd)" = integrity's clone (structure-integrity.md line ~956). All clone-reads.
readers_by_pattern.verify-pending-run-*.json: written by verify-pending-state.js from decider's clone; consumed by prune-integrity + archive-old-reports (clone). No FUSE reader.
readers_by_pattern.narrative-cite-audit-*.json: written by audit-narrative-citations.js from workspace-sync's clone (state-verification.md line ~139); consumed by prune-integrity archive + check-prune-resurrection (clone/git-side). No FUSE reader.
readers_by_pattern.push-failure-*.json: normally clone-written (decider-patches-and-selfapply.md line ~136 'still commit normally'); the degraded push-failure path writes to ${WORKSPACE} (line ~576) — that is a FUSE-WRITE rescued FUSE→git by workspace-sync, then read from clones. Not a git→FUSE dependency.
readers_by_pattern.git-to-fuse-divergence-*.json: written by step4c into the clone, pushed by dome-mirror/workspace-sync; consumed by prune-integrity (clone). No FUSE reader.
readers_by_pattern.workspace-sync-abort-*.json / workspace-: FUSE-WRITTEN in degraded paths (clone unavailable is precisely the trigger), rescued FUSE→git by workspace-sync's append-only walker; tinker/integrity scan them git-side. git→FUSE copy-back is pure round-trip noise. No FUSE reader.
readers_by_pattern.workspace-sync-runs/run-*.json (per-cycl: written by workspace-sync from its clone; tinker-infrastructure.md soft-complaints grep runs from tinker's FULL clone (post-ISS-3001 discipline: monitor/integrity consumers invoke from clone). Clone-read.
readers_by_pattern.prune-integrity-runs/run-*.json: written by prune-integrity from its clone; no reader found anywhere outside prune-integrity itself. Clone-only.
readers_by_pattern.fallback_per_directive: None needed — no pattern has a confirmed FUSE reader, so no pattern is retained-synced and no Option-2 subset is required.

part_A_reader_verification.explicitly_out_of_scope_and_unaffected: workspace-sync-skips.jsonl (classified 'git', read by integrity §7d from the workspace mount BY DESIGN — it is a growing .jsonl copied via copyIfExists, not the append_only walker; untouched). latest-integrity-summary.txt (.txt — synced via step4c OVERWRITE_ALLOWLIST, untouched). alerts.txt, drift-audit.json, human-notes.json, curmudgeon-dispatcher-state.json ('git'), integrity-mechanical-state.json ('git') — none match the excluded patterns.

part_B_exclusion_design.mechanism: Add a module-level FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT regex array to build.js next to OWNERSHIP, and one guard line inside walkAppendOnly's walk(): after computing rel, `if (FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT.some(re => re.test(rel))) continue;`. This is the single git→FUSE conduit for these files — syncToWorkspace() is called by build.js publish, build.js sync-workspace, and sync-workspace-step4c.js line ~507 (`execSync('node build.js sync-workspace')`), so one edit covers decider publishes, dome-mirror cycles, and manual syncs. No change to workspace-sync.md (FUSE→git rescue direction must keep working for degraded-path FUSE-born sentinels), no change to prune-integrity.js, no change to the FUSE unlink deny.
part_B_exclusion_design.pattern_notes: All 9 prune-integrity policy patterns are covered, plus 4 recurring per-run sentinel classes that prune does NOT yet manage (sync-workspace-step4c-crash, workspace-sync-delete-gate, dome-mirror-abort, prune-integrity-runs/). The report- pattern is date-anchored (report-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) so it can never catch a non-dated file. Archives are double-protected: (a) *-archive.jsonl fails the walker's .json extension filter anyway, (b) every archive is explicitly classified 'git-append-only' and flows through copyIfExists, not walkAppendOnly — the exclusion list is not even on their code path. One-off diagnostic files (prop-069-deployment-validation, prop-066/068-synthetic-test-results, decider-step-cost-summary, dome-mirror-finding, INTEGRITY-INCIDENT-*, prop-009-gate-false-positive) are deliberately NOT excluded: they are not prune-managed, never become orphans, and low-volume — scope discipline over completeness.
part_B_exclusion_design.claude_md_edit: Add one paragraph to CLAUDE.md File Ownership rules documenting the new class: 'transient-no-fuse: per-run integrity artifacts are git-only by design (DIRECTIVE-20260801-001/PROP-145); never add a FUSE read of these paths; new per-run integrity patterns MUST be added to FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT in build.js at creation time (same discipline as OWNERSHIP registration — this is now part of the ISS-3000/3001/3011/3019 registration-gap class).'
part_B_exclusion_design.registration_gap_guard: check-ownership-registration-gap.js (PROP-141) continues to require OWNERSHIP/append-only classification for new files; the CLAUDE.md paragraph extends the same checklist with the FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT question. Optional Phase 2 (not required for apply): teach the lint to flag new monitor/integrity per-run-shaped patterns absent from FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT.

preserved_unconditionally: monitor/integrity/report-archive.jsonl, workspace-sync-abort-archive.jsonl, git-to-fuse-divergence-archive.jsonl, sync-workspace-runs-archive.jsonl, sync-workspace-non-ff-abort-archive.jsonl (created by prune policies; .jsonl → outside walker scope; archive class per CLAUDE.md)
monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-skips.jsonl ('git' — integrity §7d FUSE read is by design and keeps working)
part_C_preserved_durable_record.part_A_retained_syncs: None — Part A found zero FUSE readers, so no per-run pattern needs retained sync.

part_D_delete_propagation_disposition.recommendation: Flip delete_propagation.enabled=false (manifest-only) and REWRITE the config _notes/_phase to the new reality — do NOT remove the pass.
part_D_delete_propagation_disposition.rationale: (1) The candidate computation is the live instrument behind the PROP-125 delete-propagation-backlog canary (check-delete-propagation-backlog.js reads delete_propagation.candidates from the newest sentinel). Post-exclusion, candidates≈0 is the EXPECTED steady state, which converts the canary into a free regression detector: if anyone adds a new per-run pattern without registering it in FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT, candidates resume growing and the canary fires at 200 — exactly the failure class this PROP creates. (2) There is a known final tail: ~142 FUSE files currently matching DELETE_PATTERNS (category_total in sentinel sync-workspace-runs-2026-08-02T00-35-11Z.json) are still git-tracked/fresh; over the next 7-90 days prune will delete them from git and they become the LAST orphan cohort (~142 max, minus any the operator's 08-01 drain already removed once aged). One final small operator drain around 2026-09/10 clears it; after that only rare degraded-path FUSE-born sentinels (aborts/crashes/push-failures, historically ~10 files in 2 months) trickle in — decades from the 200 threshold. (3) enabled=true is currently a false claim: scheduled sessions EPERM on unlink, so 'delete' mode never deletes; manifest-only is the honest description of what the pass can actually do without a present human.
part_D_delete_propagation_disposition.config_notes_replacement: delete_propagation._notes → 'MANIFEST-ONLY by design since DIRECTIVE-20260801-001/PROP-145 (2026-08): per-run integrity artifacts are no longer mirrored to FUSE (FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT in build.js), so no new orphans accumulate. candidates = final pre-exclusion tail aging out through ~2026-10 (≤142 files; one last operator drain) + rare degraded-path FUSE-born sentinels thereafter. Steady state: candidates ≈ 0. The PROP-125 canary (threshold 200) now doubles as the exclusion-regression detector — if candidates trend up again, a new per-run pattern is missing from FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT. Do not flip enabled=true: scheduled sessions EPERM on FUSE unlink; drains are operator-interactive by design (the deny is the 2026-05-21 disaster-recovery property).' _phase → 'post-DIRECTIVE-20260801-001 — mirroring stopped at source'.
part_D_delete_propagation_disposition.delete_patterns_kept_in_sync: The three-way mirror rule (prune-integrity POLICIES ↔ step4c DELETE_PATTERNS ↔ workspace-sync is_prune_expired) stays as-is; FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT becomes the FOURTH surface in that edit-one-edit-all comment set. Update the mirror comments in all three existing files to mention it.

secondary_observations_not_blocking: prune-integrity-runs/run-*.json has NO prune policy — prune-integrity never prunes its own run reports (119 git-tracked and growing ~1/day). Suggest a follow-up policy {retention_days: 30, keep_last_n: 20, archive: prune-integrity-runs-archive.jsonl}. Independent of this PROP; the exclusion already stops their FUSE mirroring.

dome-mirror-abort-*.json, sync-workspace-step4c-crash-*.json, workspace-sync-delete-gate-*.json also lack prune policies (low volume; aborts are operator-significant). Fine to leave; noting for completeness.
monitor/integrity/disk-test.txt and .touchtest are junk tracked in git — operator may delete at leisure.
proposed_fix_summary: 1-line guard + regex array in build.js walkAppendOnly (git→FUSE create-only walker); config flip enabled=false + honest _notes rewrite in sync-workspace-step4c.config.json; one CLAUDE.md ownership paragraph; mirror-comment updates in prune-integrity.js / sync-workspace-step4c.js / workspace-sync.md. Zero changes to: FUSE unlink deny, workspace-sync FUSE→git rescue, prune-integrity behavior, any archive, any site-critical FUSE protection.

tradeoffs.cost_1: Ad-hoc humans browsing FUSE (Finder/iCloud) lose local visibility of per-run integrity artifacts — must use git/GitHub instead. These are agent forensics, not operator artifacts; CLAUDE.md already directs all agents to clone-reads for them.
tradeoffs.cost_2: If a FUTURE consumer legitimately needs a FUSE read of one of these patterns, it must either repoint to clone (preferred, matches PROP-078 clone-source-of-truth discipline) or remove that pattern from the exclusion list (one-line, reviewable).
tradeoffs.cost_3: The final ~142-file tail still needs ONE more operator drain (~2026-09/10) — this PROP prevents recurrence, it does not retroactively clean FUSE (cannot: unlink deny).

estimated_impact: Eliminates the recurring 1-2-month operator FUSE-drain chore permanently (2 drains so far: 1,137 + ~260 files). Removes ~10-15 orphan-candidates/day accumulation. PROP-125 canary repurposed from drain-timer to regression-detector at zero cost. FUSE workspace stops growing with forensic noise (~119-file prune-integrity-runs mirror, 94 report mirrors, etc. stop at current size).
verification_pattern: POST-APPLY (grade A, mechanical): (1) node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('build.js','utf8'); if(!/FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT/.test(s)) {console.log('MISSING array');process.exit(1)}; if(!/FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT\.some/.test(s)){console.log('guard not wired into walkAppendOnly');process.exit(1)}; console.log('FIXED')" — exits 0 with FIXED when both the array and the walker guard exist. (2) Behavioral: from a clone, run `node build.js sync-workspace` and confirm its output line reports 0 new append-only files under monitor/integrity/ matching the excluded patterns while a deliberately-new monitor/analyst/analysis-records/*.json still syncs (walker otherwise intact). (3) Config: node -e "const c=require('./monitor/scripts/sync-workspace-step4c.config.json'); process.exit(c.delete_propagation.enabled===false&&/DIRECTIVE-20260801-001/.test(c.delete_propagation._notes)?0:1)". (4) Steady-state (2+ weeks post-apply): newest sync-workspace-runs-*.json sentinel delete_propagation.candidates does not exceed the pre-apply final-tail projection (≤142) and trends down after the final drain; PROP-125 canary silent.
rollback: Single revert of the build.js guard line + array (git revert or manual). Config flip back is one push. No data migration in either direction — the exclusion only affects future copies.

operator_decision.sanity: node --check clean (build.js + both scripts); config json valid; verification pattern 1 (FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT array + walkAppendOnly guard) FIXED; pattern 3 (config enabled=false + DIRECTIVE-20260801-001 stamp) FIXED; exclusion unit-test all-correct (13 transient patterns excluded; archives, workspace-sync-skips.jsonl, dispatcher-state, analysis-records, curmudgeon reviews all KEPT); 3838/3838 tests. Behavioral sync test (pattern 2) not runnable in cloud container (sync-workspace no-ops without a FUSE mount) — substituted by the regex unit-test.
operator_decision.followups: (1) 2-week steady-state watch (pattern 4): backlog trends down + PROP-125 canary silent. (2) One final small operator drain ~2026-09/10 clears the pre-exclusion tail (<=142 files aging out of git). (3) Optional Phase 2: teach check-ownership-registration-gap.js to flag new per-run integrity patterns missing from FUSE_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT (not required for this apply).
